_provenance: schema-derived from O6 spec and existing autotune_runs migration pattern (006_autotune_runs_sharpe.sql)
_description: Expected schema additions for migration 007: validation_sharpe and frozen_eval_sharpe columns in autotune_runs
_not_target: optuna_studies.db (that is Optuna's internal DB, separate from alphabot_state.db)

new_columns.name: validation_sharpe
new_columns.description: Sortino ratio on the validation fold — the metric Optuna trial selection is scored against
new_columns._note: Previously called oos_alpha but now semantically distinct: validation_sharpe is used for SELECTION, frozen_eval_sharpe is the honest reporting metric

new_columns.name: frozen_eval_sharpe
new_columns.description: Sortino ratio on the frozen evaluation fold — evaluated ONCE after best trial selection, never consumed during the Optuna sweep
new_columns._note: This is the honest OOS reporting metric that eliminates the reporting bias identified in the audit

migration_constraints._note: Follows project CLAUDE.md additive-first pattern: NULLable + DEFAULT NULL, no destructive changes
